unavailable_fields.nccl_tuning.algorithm_protocol_channel: Single-device task; no NCCL collectives in the measured invocation (observations.json reports communication not_applicable), so there are no actual algorithm/protocol decisions to capture.
unavailable_fields.collective_calibration.synthetic_allredu: No distributed world exists; a full-world SUM allreduce at observed sizes is not applicable to this single-GPU workload.
unavailable_fields.device_telemetry.per_call_site_or_pcie_b: NVML readings are device-wide with native windows; they cannot attribute bytes to the two intercepted call sites, so requesting them would not resolve the open questions.
unavailable_fields.binding_cost.per_call_site_or_per_group_: binding_cost omits candidate build/computation and reports whole-invocation AB/BA cost only; per-site (parent-eager vs parent-passthrough) timing decomposition is unavailable.

unavailable_fields.candidate_diagnostics.successful_path_id: Empty diagnostics events cannot establish which successful path executed (no normal calls or non-False scalar returns are recorded), and no collector compares intermediate tensors or locates a first numerical divergence.

rationale: Evidence: torch already ran (coverage.json: 66441/66441 kernels associated, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous), the task is single-device (observations.json: communication not_applicable), and this additive candidate 62dd58ec (bundle trial-cf72c8a39d-param-65bdefc5, effective direct binding with reason 'no functional replacements') passed quality but was not accepted: paired TTFT 26.73 ms vs parent 28.78 ms is within noise, and both sit above the original reference 24.61 ms. Two uncertainties remain. (1) Route attribution: the candidate self-reports call site 2441f10600ba127de5cb753c as parent-eager (2 calls) and call site e7df98b905ed8aa688d5227a as parent-passthrough (62 calls); these labels are candidate telemetry, not independent proof. execution_timeline supplies a separate plain Torch trace with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events around the explicit first-token-ready torch.cuda.synchronize(), and per-device intervals to corroborate which code path actually launched kernels at those call sites and whether host-side gaps inside the TTFT window exist. candidate_diagnostics adds actual exception evidence (handled exceptions with library traceback locations and False returns) distinguishing a genuine passthrough from a silent fallback. (2) Whether the additive binding layer itself masks a real gain despite 'no functional replacements': binding_cost runs clean AB/BA workers comparing the candidate's parent against a binding-only passthrough with full quality checks, directly measuring whole-invocation binding overhead; if selected it also feeds subsequent candidate resource feedback. nsys is skipped because kernel-to-op attribution is already complete from the prior torch run and no graph-tracing or stream-overlap question exists; python_runtime is skipped because it perturbs execution and binding_cost already measures binding/dispatch overhead cleanly; nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and device_telemetry are inapplicable to a single-GPU eager workload with no collectives. No PCIe/NVLink traffic is inferred from payload sizes, and no optimization action or failure-category policy is prescribed by this plan.
